bugs.title: State Carryover Bug
bugs.description: Previous request gets executed again when user sends a new/different request. Form data from prior tool execution persists and leaks into the next tool execution.
bugs.fix_details: Capture all form values BEFORE async call, clear form immediately, prevent stale dataset.tool from persisting. Close modal after execution.
bugs.root_cause: formElement.reset() was called AFTER async response returned. If user opened a new tool modal during the wait, the reset would wipe the NEW tool's inputs, and dataset.tool would still point to old tool name.

bugs.title: Token Expiration Error
bugs.description: User gets 'token expired' error after 30 minutes of inactivity, losing their session.
bugs.fix_details: Extended ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES from 30 to 1440 (24 hours). Added 401 detection in frontend with graceful logout message.
bugs.root_cause: JWT token lifetime was only 30 minutes. No frontend handling for 401 responses.

bugs.title: Copilot Response Not Captured
bugs.description: Ask Copilot output doesn't appear in the app. AppleScript can send queries but cannot capture the actual response from VS Code Copilot Chat. Cmd+A/Cmd+C selects editor content, not Copilot Chat text.
bugs.fix_details: v4 FINAL: Replaced AppleScript entirely. Now uses GitHub Models API (direct HTTP calls to AI with user's paid Copilot subscription). Instant responses, no clipboard/capture needed.
bugs.root_cause: AppleScript Cmd+A/Cmd+C captured editor content, not Copilot Chat panel. VS Code Electron UI doesn't expose chat text to accessibility APIs. Solution: bypass VS Code entirely, call AI directly via API.

bugs.title: SyntaxError in tools.py
bugs.description: Server fails to start with SyntaxError due to malformed f-strings with escaped quotes inside triple-quoted strings.
bugs.fix_details: Regenerated tools.py with proper string concatenation instead of broken f-strings.
bugs.root_cause: Python f-strings with escaped quotes (backslash-quote) inside triple-quoted strings cause SyntaxError.

bugs.title: File Browser Bug
bugs.description: Doesn’t open a file says not found, and folder doesn’t open says not found
bugs.fix_details: browsePath() was using raw emoji-prefixed strings (📁 name/, 📄 name (1KB)) as filenames in paths. Fixed: parse list_files output properly, strip emojis/size info, detect dirs by trailing /. Folders now navigate into them. Files read content directly. Added parent directory (..) navigation.
bugs.root_cause: list_files returns formatted lines like '📁 Documents/' and '📄 config.py  (1.7KB)'. browsePath() was using these raw strings as path components, creating paths like '/Users/xxvirusxx/📁 Documents/' which don't exist.
